study: spec 016: time-late, classical controls and a learned whole-period model (study L)
statistic: per period, the median relative range error over scored rows (30 s apart, known-history bound below 0.5); a ratio a ÷ b is the geometric mean over periods with a 95% period bootstrap (2,000 resamples, seed 17, percentile); a side wins when the interval is wholly above 1 and loses when wholly below

criteria.L-a: validation seed 340, controls only: history-fixed range efficiency on rows bounded below 0.05 within [0.8, 1.3]; at least 0.9 of true-history fits with a consistent cost; at most 0.25 of references held. Fails: the study stops before the test seed
criteria.L-b: reported, no line: search3 ÷ ctl-d1-q0.01 on shift, shift2, man2-corr, man2-out, and the share of the gap from search3 to history-best that ctl closes
criteria.L-c: on each of shift, shift2, man2-corr, man2-out, man2-bias: 'shown' if every seed's ctl-d1-q0.01 ÷ learned-sK-arc and ctl-h1 ÷ learned-sK-arc both win; 'hedging' if every seed wins the first and not every seed the second; 'not shown' otherwise
criteria.L-d: on man2 and quiet: 'harm' if every seed's ctl-d1-q0.01 ÷ learned-sK-arc loses
criteria.follows: shown on at least two mismatch splits and no harm: a gate for a learned time-late system is proposed. Shown on none: the classical controls stand and the learned track stops. Otherwise: reported, the owner decides

order: the learned model is scored on no validation or test data until the controls' validation record (run tl-e-val) is committed; tma2-tlscore refuses otherwise. Training reads stream seed 339 only. The test seed is scored once
power: research.md, 'As registered': a learned track must differ from the control by about 15% (shift) to 40% (shift2) to be separated; less reads 'not separated'

forecasts.L-b: search3 ÷ ctl: outliers about 1.5, correlated about 1.3, shift 1.0 to 1.1, shift2 1.1 to 1.2; gap closed: outliers over 0.6, correlated about 0.5, shift under 0.2
forecasts.L-c: not shown on outliers or correlated errors (the control is near the reference there). Shift is the one split with room: about one chance in four that learning is shown there. Bias: not shown. Overall most likely outcome: shown on none
forecasts.L-d: the model at 12.5 million periods is likely worse than the control on Annex B data (pilot: median |ln range| error 0.095 at 1.5 million periods against the control's 0.03): harm on man2 is more likely than not for the direct track; the arc read-out narrows it and may avoid 'harm'
forecasts.direct against arc: the read-out improves on the model's own track on most splits

known_limits: the evidence faults at the edges of the prior's support (experiments/20261113-tl3/review.md, major 5) are not repaired; the declaration margin was tuned with them in place
the correlated-error control is one effective sd, not a whitened fit, and was built knowing the generator's error family
only wild-bearing editing is built as a robust form
the training budget is 12.5 million periods a seed; a null result is a result at this budget, not a limit of learning
the ledger under-counts a run whose container is replaced
the test run file's learned branches and controls_record are added by addendum before the test is launched; its splits and sizes are bound here
